# Bayside IT Partners — Master Services Agreement (Excerpt)

> Fictional contract for a practice assessment. Signed January 5, 2022, by Priya Natarajan (CFO). Auto-renews every year on January 5 unless either side gives 60 days' notice.

**Section 4 — Services.** Bayside will provide after-hours help desk support, server maintenance, firewall rule reviews each quarter, and 24/7 monitoring of endpoint security alerts.

**Section 6 — Access.** Client will give Bayside administrator-level access to client systems as needed to perform the Services.

**Section 9 — Confidentiality.** Each party will keep the other's confidential information private using reasonable care.

**Section 11 — Limitation of liability.** Bayside's total liability under this Agreement will not exceed the fees paid by Client in the **one (1) month** before the claim.

**Section 14 — Term.** Initial term of 12 months, renewing automatically for additional 12-month terms.

*(No other sections address security, audits, incident notification, data location, subcontractors, or what happens to client data when the contract ends.)*

**Monthly fee:** $3,400
